stages.proof_body: Rust body intentionally not used for behavioral proof

stages.trust_effect: user-written behavioral contract is accepted as a premise

stages.output: downstream proof may rely on contract
stages.trust_effect: client theorem is conditional on correctness of the opaque implementation/model and asserted contract

separate_mechanisms.allow_sorry: Development-time proof-hole path for spec-mode obligations; distinct from explicit unsafe(axiom).
separate_mechanisms.noncomputable_section: Allows generated Lean definitions depending on opaque axioms to avoid bytecode-computability errors; does not discharge the axiom.
separate_mechanisms.rust_unsafe_gate: At this revision, parser uses Rust unsafety to reject requires clauses on safe functions, but no inspected branch rejects unsafe(axiom) mode itself on a safe function.

modeled_progress.wp_spec_semantics: spec m P iff there exists y with m = ok y and P y
modeled_progress.consequence: Under the generated precondition, unsafe(axiom) asserts modeled successful return and postcondition; fail and div are excluded.
modeled_progress.trust_boundary: Because the Rust body is opaque, real progress/termination is assumed by the axiom rather than proved.
